financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of 6,110,000 common shares at $6.550 per share (gross proceeds; net not stated; expected closing date)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The Company estimates gross proceeds from the Offering, before deducting the underwriting discounts and commissions and other estimated offering expenses payable by the Company, will be approximately $40,020,500 million.
